rules.name: Classic remote-thread injection API cluster
rules.description: OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory and CreateRemoteThread imported together: the textbook DLL/shellcode injection sequence.

rules.name: APC queue injection API cluster
rules.description: QueueUserAPC or NtQueueApcThread with remote allocation and write APIs.

rules.name: Process hollowing API cluster
rules.description: Unmapping a target section and rewriting its context: NtUnmapViewOfSection, WriteProcessMemory, SetThreadContext and ResumeThread.

rules.name: Thread hijacking API cluster
rules.description: SuspendThread, GetThreadContext, SetThreadContext with a remote write.

rules.name: Transacted-file process creation cluster
rules.description: NtCreateTransaction / CreateFileTransacted combined with NtCreateProcessEx or NtCreateSection: transacted-image process creation.

rules.name: Reflective loader export
rules.description: An export or string named ReflectiveLoader, the entry point of Stephen Fewer's public reflective DLL injection technique and its many derivatives.

rules.name: Raw x64 direct-syscall stub
rules.description: The mov r10,rcx; mov eax,imm; syscall; ret stub, embedded in a binary other than ntdll, is the signature of direct-syscall EDR evasion. ntdll itself and some security products contain it.

rules.name: AMSI scan-buffer patching cluster
rules.description: amsi.dll, AmsiScanBuffer and VirtualProtect together: the shape of in-memory AMSI bypasses.

rules.name: ETW event-write patching cluster
rules.description: ntdll, EtwEventWrite and VirtualProtect: disabling event tracing by patching the writer.

rules.name: ntdll unhooking via KnownDlls or disk copy
rules.description: Mapping a fresh ntdll image from \KnownDlls or System32 to overwrite hooked code.

rules.name: Virtual machine / sandbox artefact strings
rules.description: Checks for VirtualBox, VMware or Sandboxie artefacts by name.

rules.name: Anti-debugging API cluster
rules.description: IsDebuggerPresent, CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent, NtQueryInformationProcess and OutputDebugString together. Common in protectors and some games.

rules.name: Debug-privilege acquisition cluster
rules.description: SeDebugPrivilege with OpenProcessToken and AdjustTokenPrivileges: needed for many injectors and dumpers, but also for debuggers and installers.

rules.name: Keylogger API cluster
rules.description: SetWindowsHookEx with a keyboard hook, GetAsyncKeyState/GetKeyboardState and GetForegroundWindow/GetWindowText for window titles.

rules.name: Screen capture and clipboard harvesting cluster
rules.description: BitBlt screen capture with GetDC and clipboard reads, plus a network send API. Remote-support tools match too.

rules.name: Shadow-copy and recovery sabotage strings in a binary
rules.description: vssadmin/wmic shadow deletion together with bcdedit recovery tampering, embedded in an executable.

rules.name: Event log clearing strings in a binary
rules.description: wevtutil clear-log or EvtClearLog together with log names Security/System.

rules.name: LD_PRELOAD-style userland rootkit strings
rules.description: ELF references /etc/ld.so.preload and hooks readdir/dlsym/fopen to hide files and processes.

rules.name: ELF process-injection helper strings
rules.description: ptrace attach, /proc/<pid>/mem writes and dlopen string: Linux shared-library injection tooling.

rules.name: Mach-O AppleScript password-prompt strings
rules.description: Embedded osascript command that raises a fake password dialog with a hidden answer and then reads the keychain.

rules.name: Mach-O browser/keychain credential harvesting strings
rules.description: Paths to the login keychain and Chromium Login Data / Safe Storage secrets in one image.

rules.name: Mach-O quarantine attribute removal
rules.description: xattr -d / -c of com.apple.quarantine inside an executable: stripping Gatekeeper's mark from a dropped payload.
